1ba4cd78ce.q: What are the main use cases where generative AI has genuinely moved the needle according to recent progress?
1ba4cd78ce.a: Agentic coding and LLM-assisted coding represent the leading edge where generative AI is working well. Around the end of last year, LLM coding transitioned from augmenting what humans could do to performing most work mostly correctly most of the time, with humans intervening only in minor ways. Breakthroughs have also emerged in solving open problems in mathematics and theoretical physics, where AI serves as a tool for generating new ideas.

87b23ecc80.q: What is the core difference between generative AI and agentic AI in terms of capabilities and autonomy?
87b23ecc80.a: Generative AI at its core uses a large language model to produce text, wrapped in a system providing additional capabilities like data retrieval and action-taking. Agentic AI adds the ability to take autonomous decisions and reason about what it should do, rather than following prescriptive rules. For example, instead of pre-defining exactly how to handle a refund, agentic AI gives the LLM the opportunity to assess the customer situation and come up with a reasonable solution autonomously.

f: Generative AI at its core uses a large language model to produce text, wrapped in a system providing additional capabilities like data retrieval and action-taking. Agentic AI adds a layer of autonomy by giving the language model the ability to make decisions and reason about what it should do, rather than following prescriptive rules. Instead of pre-defining exactly how to handle a refund, agentic AI allows the LLM to assess the customer situation and come up with a reasonable solution independently. The ability to take real action in the world is not new with agentic systems, but the key difference lies in granting the system agency to reason and decide autonomously about its next steps.

People are now discovering where to dial up autonomy versus control when building these systems. Regulated industries and compliance-critical applications benefit from more prescriptive, rule-based approaches where steps must be enforced for legal obligations. However, complex problem-solving tasks with high variation, such as conversations where outcomes cannot be predicted, are better suited for agentic AI because they require flexibility. Alan Nicol emphasizes that the challenge is figuring out the right composition of control and autonomy for each use case, as systems can become unreliable when autonomy is not properly balanced, sometimes skipping important steps.

aac4813a13.q: How has the balance between LLM autonomy and structured control in AI system architectures evolved over the past 12 to 18 months?
aac4813a13.a: There has been a reversal in architectural approaches. Previously, engineers built strict workflows and sprinkled LLM processing on top for rephrasing and information extraction. Now, given the dramatic progress in model capabilities, organizations start with the LLM as the primary layer and add determinism and control on top as an additional layer. This reversal became possible only because the rate of progress in model capabilities is so high.

1037720f4b.q: When should organizations use rule-based systems versus agentic AI for complex business processes?
1037720f4b.a: If you already know exactly how a business process works, running it through an LLM adds no value. However, for regulated industries and compliance-critical steps, you want to enforce specific procedures because you are legally obligated to do so. The key is pairing LLM capabilities with structured control in a way that lets the LLM work effectively while maintaining necessary guardrails and determinism for risk management.

3a25a7b63d.q: Why is the McDonald's chatbot example significant for understanding AI guardrails in production systems?
3a25a7b63d.a: McDonald's implemented a chatbot in their app to help users decide what to order but did not put proper guardrails around it. Users discovered they could use it to write code, causing the company's API bills to skyrocket. This demonstrates why governance, control, and deliberate design behind how AI agents operate is critical to prevent unintended usage and cost overruns in production applications.
